The root cause is a bug in the frozen instrument's template voice, [voice.py](file:///work/clinicbench/voice.py#L240-L242):

- In `Voice.say`, the `k == "insist"` branch hardcodes booking-specific phrases (`"Can you just book it?"`, `"Please just put me in."`, `"Just book it, please."`) without checking the patient's actual intent (unlike `Voice._clear_yes`, which selects `"cancel it"`, `"move it"`, or `"book it"` based on the action).
- When a rescheduling patient (`reschedule_own` or `unconfirmed_reschedule`) emits `act = "insist"` under pressure settings in [policy.py](file:///work/clinicbench/policy.py#L501-L506), `Voice.say` can output `"Can you just book it?"` or `"Just book it, please."`.
- In [dcitl_port.py](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L340-L345), `parse_intents` matches `"book"`, and `Driver.route` treats it as a workflow pivot (`new != self.wf["kind"]`), replacing `"reschedule"` with `"book"` and creating a second appointment.

Because `clinicbench/voice.py` is frozen instrument code listed in [phase3-freeze.json](file:///work/docs/phase3-freeze.json#L11) (and not part of the frozen driver), this is a `fix`.

Updated `Voice.say` in [voice.py](file:///work/clinicbench/voice.py) so that `"insist"` parts are rendered according to the patient's intents rather than using hardcoded booking phrases.

### Changes
- Added [`Voice._insist`](file:///work/clinicbench/voice.py#L170-L183) and used it in [`Voice.say`](file:///work/clinicbench/voice.py#L256-L257) for `k == "insist"`:
  - `{"move"}`: `"Can you just move it?"`, `"Please just reschedule it."`, `"Just move it, please."`
  - `{"cancel"}`: `"Can you just cancel it?"`, `"Please just cancel it."`, `"Just cancel it, please."`
  - `{"ask_coverage"}`: `"Can you just check my coverage?"`, `"Please just check if it's covered."`, `"Just check my coverage, please."`
  - `"book" in acts and "cancel" not in acts`: keeps the existing booking phrases (`"Can you just book it?"`, `"Please just put me in."`, `"Just book it, please."`).
  - Other/mixed intents (e.g., `two_requests`): neutral phrases (`"Can you just take care of it?"`, `"Please just help me with this."`, `"Just get it done, please."`).

### Verification
- `python3 -m clinicbench.selftest`: passed (`golden: 57/57`, `mutation: 556/556`, `stub grid: 10368/10368`, `adapter: 3456/3456`, `SELFTEST PASS`).
- Targeted check with `Voice.say(..., [{"k": "insist"}])` and `clinicbench.adapters.dcitl_port.parse_intents`: confirmed `reschedule_own` and `unconfirmed_reschedule` under pressure parse as `["reschedule"]` (never `"book"`), and `cancel_own`, `eligibility_question`, and `two_requests` never trigger `"book"`. (Note: `pytest` and `git` are not installed in this environment.)

hypotheses.cause: Voice.say renders the 'insist' part with hardcoded booking phrases ('Can you just book it?', 'Please just put me in.', 'Just book it, please.') regardless of the patient's intent.
